definitions.explanation: A standard quantity used to measure or express amounts.
A unit representing completion of a course in school or university.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}さの{単位|たんい}はメートルだ。
examples.english: The unit of length is the meter.

examples.japanese: {卒業|そつぎょう}に{必要|ひつよう}な{単位|たんい}を{取|と}った。
examples.english: I earned the credits needed for graduation.

examples.japanese: この{授業|じゅぎょう}は2{単位|たんい}だ。
{温度|おんど}の{単位|たんい}は{摂氏|せっし}と{華氏|かし}がある。
examples.english: There are Celsius and Fahrenheit as units of temperature.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{距離|きょり}の{単位|たんい}にキロメートルを{使|つか}う。
examples.english: In Japan, kilometers are used as the unit of distance.

examples.japanese: {単位|たんい}が{足|た}りなくて{卒業|そつぎょう}できなかった。
examples.english: I couldn't graduate because I lacked credits.

notes:
SENSE 1 - UNITS:
- {長|なが}さの{単位|たんい} (unit of length)
- {重|おも}さの{単位|たんい} (unit of weight)
- {時間|じかん}の{単位|たんい} (unit of time)

SENSE 2 - ACADEMIC:
- {単位|たんい}を{取|と}る (to earn credits)
- {単位|たんい}が{足|た}りない (to lack credits)
- {必修単位|ひっしゅうたんい} (required credits)
- {選択単位|せんたくたんい} (elective credits)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {単位制|たんいせい} (credit system)
- {単位|たんい}{認定|にんてい} (credit certification)
